tools.name: search
tools.description: Search ATK Magazine. tier FREE hits are published articles with free full text at url (markdown at url + '.md', or call get_article). tier PAID hits are EXAMPLE/TEST content, not published: abstracts and prices only (0.20 USDC via x402); bodies require x402 payment at price.paywall.

tools.name: get_preview
tools.description: Free: first two paragraphs, problem, audience, teaser and refund policy for one article. No payment.

tools.name: get_article
tools.description: Published FREE articles: returns the full markdown text. PAID example articles: full article requires x402 payment (0.20 USDC); returns the payment URL and requirements; pay via HTTP 402 at that URL.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.
